page.overview:
What is Land of Fiction?

The Land of Fiction is a dimension created by BBC in 1968 for Doctor Who.

The Land of Fiction first appeared in an adventure involving the second incarnation of The Doctor. It was later stated as having been created by the Gods of Ragnarok for their own entertainment, but eventually they grew bored of the Land of Fiction and abandoned it. The dimension is inhabited by characters from various works of folklore, mythology, and fiction.
